run_EMG_model_training: run the emg2qwerty training pipeline with hydra config to train a PyTorch Lightning model
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume EMG model training from the last checkpoint in the checkpoints directory
load_model_from_checkpoint: load a pre-trained EMG model from a checkpoint file with optimizer and decoder config
build_transform_pipeline: build a composed transform pipeline from a sequence of hydra transform config entries
validate_and_test_model: validate and test the EMG model on val and test datasets and print metrics
